notes.title: Achievements bug and 29 levels unlocked
notes.content:
Patch for the following issues:
- achievements did not unlock for level 1-25.
- level 1-29 were unlocked

If your game had the 29 levels unlocked you will need to do some fixing yourself, since I do not want to wipe everyone's save file.

Before you do this, you might lose your save data.
I will show you how to restore your save data again so do not worry.
Just remember which level you had unlocked.

1) Under options there is a new button called "reset all data"
click it. you will lose all old save data ( non steam cloud )
2) exit the game
3) browse the local files for cubelink
go to the folder cubelink_data/savesDir and open the file save.sav with a text editor (notepad)
4) type in the number of levels you had unlocked

After restarting the game you will have the correct amount of levels unlocked
when you unlock a level, you will get all your missing achievements.

I will try to come up with a smoother way to fix this.

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
Fixed several bugs.

the following 2 bugs were caused by adding cloudsupport :
- Fixed a bug that broke the tutorial because it thought it was in a different level
- Fixed a bug where players could unlock levels by replaying old levels

- Fixed a bug where leaving the credit screen resulted in a overlaying credit screen on top of the game
